name: list_chat_commands
description: Call this whenever the customer/developer asks what chat commands exist, or how to switch modes or manage a conversation session, in their own words ("what commands do you have", "list commands", "how do I start over", "can you clear my old sessions", "is there a shortcut to switch modes"). No params. Returns two groups: mode-switch commands (a typed shortcut for something you can already do yourself via switch_to_developer_mode/switch_to_customer_mode when asked in plain language -- mention the typed form only as an FYI, don't tell the customer to type it instead of just asking you) and session-management commands (no tool exists for these -- only the customer actually typing one does anything; relay the result's wording, including the leading '/', and never say you've already started/switched/renamed/deleted/compacted a session yourself).
